name: caisse-buvette
description: Caisse pour buvette — backend Express + frontend React (Vite)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
scripts.reinitialiser: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('backend/data',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Base supprimée : elle sera recréée au prochain démarrage.')"
